Independent exact-proposal review of the full repair-reviewer-1-0-v2.json packet. I am distinct from andi-pl-worker and pl_blind, and did not author the proposal. No registry or prior verdict/source-review output was read. I read the refreshed complete candidate and verified that both justification and reference_or_counterexample now explicitly define f(t)=t²/2 on R, eliminating the unbound “Same f” reference. The source, Lean statement, decoder reconstruction and whole-module/lesson context retain their mathematical content. This acceptance is bound to the v2 packet/proposal hashes recorded here.

Primary-source grounding was checked directly in the bounded session at https://arxiv.org/html/2605.07006v1: Section 3 uses C² Euclidean objectives; Theorem 3.6 combines β-smoothness and PL with α>0 without convexity; Definition 2.5 fixes the 2α normalization; the Section 2 convention supplies an attained minimum. The exact proposal retains these premises and the positive β reciprocal domain, adding only h≥0 to the printed upper restriction.

Complete counterexample: f(t)=t²/2 has derivative t and Hessian 1, is 1-smooth, has global minimizer z=0 and satisfies ‖∇f(t)‖²=t²=2(f(t)−f(0)). Thus α=β=1 meet the source hypotheses. With x₀=1,N=1,h=−1, the actual step is T(1)=2, its gap is 2, and the claimed bound is (1−αh)(f(1)−f(0))=1. The inequality fails. For every h<0, its discrepancy is ((1−h)²−(1−h))/2=(h²−h)/2>0. This is an actual attained-minimum PL counterexample, not a recurrence-only example or an arbitrary-comparator substitution. Every negative step must therefore be excluded for a guarantee uniform over the unchanged class.

Sufficiency: let G(x)=f(x)−f(z)≥0 and q=1−αh. The smooth upper model at T(x)=x−h∇f(x), together with β>0 and 0≤h≤1/β, gives G(Tx)≤G(x)−(h/2)‖∇f(x)‖². Multiplying PL by h/2≥0 yields G(Tx)≤qG(x), with coefficient exactly 1 on the initial gap and factor q^N after iteration. For q≥0 the actual iterate successor identity allows geometric induction. For q<0, 0≤G(Tx)≤qG(x) and G(x)≥0 force G(x)=0 for every x; hence both sides vanish for every natural N, including odd N. No illegitimate multiplication of an induction inequality by negative q occurs. A constant objective can satisfy the source assumptions with q<0, so an extra q≥0 or α≤β condition would unnecessarily restrict the theorem.

Minimality and endpoints: h=0 gives T=identity and q=1, so equality for all N; N=0 is equality. If q=0, the recurrence gives zero gap after one step and for all later iterates, while q^0=1 covers N=0. Thus neither h>0 nor q>0 is necessary. β>0 and α>0 remain the source reciprocal and PL domains, and the attained-minimum premise is preserved. No convexity, additional smoothness, nonnegative-coefficient premise, inverse-power interpretation or normalized-rate division is added. The counterexample proves the new h≥0 restriction is mathematically necessary for the literal all-real-step formulation, independently of Lean convenience.

Current context matches this proof: GradientDescentPL imports GradientDescentBasic and uses its canonical public gradient_step_descent_of_quadratic_upper_bound. It builds nonnegative gaps from IsMinOn, forms hrec by multiplying PL by h/2, uses le_geom with Function.iterate_succ_apply′ when q≥0, and proves hzero globally when q<0. The lesson states the same alternatives, exact normalization, actual iterates and supplied minimum. Signed local α/β, Hilbert space, and the lack of a separate differentiability premise under a global model are accurately identified as local algebraic generalizations and are not part of this source repair.

Decision accepted for this exact v2 h≥0 proposal. The missing counterexample definition has been repaired without changing the theorem or source domains. No further revision is needed. This is not blanket certification of other rate formulas, public-source completeness or the repository build; the pinned source remains separate from the accepted repair overlay.
